## Notebook Overview

**Inputs:**

- `../../../data/acs_step1_2024_block_group.feather` — 2020–2024 ACS estimates, one row per 2020 CA block group.
- `../../../data/xwalk_bg24_tr10.feather` — 2020 block group → 2010 tract allocation weights.
- `../../../data/parity_reference/acs_step2_24.feather` (optional, §1.4) —
  preserved output for schema and Southern California parity checks.

**Outputs:**

- `../../../data/acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated.feather` — 2020–2024 ACS
  measures on Southern California and Bay Area 2010 tracts for `04_assemble_tract_panel.Rmd`,
  including rental inventory, interpolated rent with median-bin evidence and
  status/flag/source-dollar bound, component rent coverage, shares, vacancy rates, and
  uncertainty measures. See the [output schema](schemas/acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated.md).

**Steps:**

1. Set up environment
2. Assemble 2020–2024 ACS block-group measures to 2010 tracts
3. Validate outputs

# 1. Set up environment

## 1.1 Load packages

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

library(here)          # project-root-relative paths via here::here()
library(Hmisc)
library(dplyr)
library(assertr)
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)
library(spatstat)
library(matrixStats)   # weightedMean() for weighted aggregation
library(survey)        # core survey analysis functions
library(srvyr)         # tidyverse-style wrapper for survey
library(forcats)
```

## 1.2 Load helper functions

```{r load-helpers}
source(here::here("R", "rent_metadata.R"))
source(here::here("R", "assemble_helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "geography_qa.R"))
source(here::here("R", "bg_aggregation_qa.R"))
```

## 1.3 Set data directory and target counties

```{r set-paths}
# Trailing slash is intentional: save_data() builds paths with paste0().
data_dir <- "../../../data/"

county_config <- step2_target_counties()
southern_california_counties <- county_config$southern_california_counties
bay_area_counties <- county_config$bay_area_counties
target_counties <- county_config$target_counties

parity_reference_dir <- "../../../data/parity_reference"
```

## 1.4 Read prior outputs for parity checks

### Decision: Preserve a separate parity reference

Set `parity_reference_dir` to a preserved snapshot directory; this product uses
`acs_step2_24.feather` as its reference filename. Saving candidates in `data_dir`
does not replace the snapshot. A missing reference means **parity not checked**.
Reference and candidate must use the same statewide inputs and measurement code,
apart from the income/count corrections verified in §2.8 and the fixed
`schema_migration = "2024"` allowance in the [output schema](schemas/acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated.md).

```{r load-parity-references}
parity_reference_files <- c(
  "2024_bg_aggregated" = "acs_step2_24.feather"
)
prior_outputs <- read_step2_parity_references(parity_reference_dir, parity_reference_files)
```

# 2. Assemble 2020–2024 ACS block-group measures to 2010 tracts

## 2.1 Import block-group ACS and crosswalk

```{r import-bg-and-xwalk-2024-bg-aggregated}
acs_2024_bg_source <- load_data(data_dir, NULL, "acs_step1_2024_block_group.feather") |>
  select(-any_of(step2_cleanup_columns("2016")))
report_n(acs_2024_bg_source, "2024 ACS block-group sources loaded")

xwalk <- load_data(data_dir, NULL, "xwalk_bg24_tr10.feather")
report_n(xwalk, "bg2020->tr2010 crosswalk loaded")
```

## 2.2 Select destination tracts and merge all contributing block groups

### Decision: Select destination tracts without renormalizing source weights

Keep all crosswalk links to **destination** tracts in `target_counties`, including
sources outside those counties, so cross-county contributions are preserved.
Full-source weights must sum to one within `1e-6` for crosswalk rounding.
Retained fractions can sum to less than one when other destinations lie outside
the sample; **do not renormalize them**.

Any positive allocation weight requires exactly one matching ACS row. Unmatched
links with all four weights zero remain as noncontributing rows, preserving
targets represented entirely by such links. Inspect `zero_weight_unmatched`
for these exceptions, including out-of-state sources absent from the CA cache.
After contributor validation, set `rent_evidence_available = FALSE` on these
unmatched rows when the column exists: no ACS row means no retained rent evidence.
Their raw evidence remains missing; missing availability flags on matched ACS
rows still fail rent validation.

Keep `bg_reference_2024` fixed at the original target links and weights so
subsequent joins and aggregation can be checked against an independent reference.

```{r merge-and-restrict-2024-bg-aggregated}
assert_unique_key(acs_2024_bg_source, "bg2020_id", "Statewide 2024 ACS block groups")
assert_unique_key(xwalk, c("bg2020_id", "tr2010_id"), "Crosswalk allocation pairs")
xwalk_target <- select_target_counties(xwalk, tr2010_id, target_counties)
report_drop(xwalk_target, nrow(xwalk), "allocations to non-target destination tracts")
source_ids <- distinct(xwalk_target, bg2020_id)

# Retain all destinations for these sources only to audit original weight sums.
xwalk_sources <- semi_join(xwalk, source_ids, by = "bg2020_id")
report_drop(xwalk_sources, nrow(xwalk), "sources with no target destination")
weight_cols <- c("wt_pop", "wt_hh", "wt_hu", "wt_renthu")
stopifnot("Crosswalk weights must be finite fractions" = all(vapply(
  xwalk_sources[weight_cols], function(w) all(is.finite(w) & w >= 0 & w <= 1), logical(1)
)))
source_weight_qa_2024_bg_aggregated <- bind_rows(
  mutate(xwalk_sources, allocation = "full"),
  mutate(xwalk_target, allocation = "retained")
) |>
  group_by(bg2020_id, allocation) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(weight_cols), sum), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(weight_cols), names_to = "weight", values_to = "fraction") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = allocation, values_from = fraction)
source_weight_qa_2024_bg_aggregated |>
  group_by(weight) |>
  summarise(sources = n(), min_full = min(full), max_full = max(full),
            min_retained = min(retained), max_retained = max(retained),
            partially_retained = sum(retained < full - 1e-6), .groups = "drop") |>
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
stopifnot("Full source weights must sum to one" = all(abs(source_weight_qa_2024_bg_aggregated$full - 1) <= 1e-6),
          "Retained weights cannot exceed original weights" =
            all(source_weight_qa_2024_bg_aggregated$retained <= source_weight_qa_2024_bg_aggregated$full + 1e-6))

# Freeze original target links only after the full-source audit, before joining ACS.
bg_reference_2024 <- new_bg_aggregation_reference(xwalk_target)
target_tract_ids_2024_bg_aggregated <- bg_reference_2024$targets

# Coverage diagnostic only: this does not select the allocation sample.
sources_without_xwalk <- select_target_counties(acs_2024_bg_source, bg2020_id, target_counties) |>
  anti_join(distinct(xwalk, bg2020_id), by = "bg2020_id")
report_n(sources_without_xwalk, "Target-county ACS sources missing from the crosswalk (expected 0)")
stopifnot(nrow(sources_without_xwalk) == 0L)

acs_sources <- semi_join(acs_2024_bg_source, source_ids, by = "bg2020_id") |>
  mutate(.acs_present = TRUE)
report_drop(acs_sources, nrow(acs_2024_bg_source), "ACS sources with no target destination")
xwalk_join <- merge_df(xwalk_target, acs_sources, "bg2020_id") |>
  mutate(.acs_present = coalesce(.acs_present, FALSE))
join_contributor_qa_2024 <- bg_aggregation_diagnostics(xwalk_join, bg_reference_2024, measures = NULL)
zero_weight_unmatched <- join_contributor_qa_2024$zero_weight_unmatched
print(head(zero_weight_unmatched, 10L), width = Inf)
report_n(zero_weight_unmatched, "Unmatched all-zero links retained as noncontributing rows")
table(xwalk_join$merge)
stopifnot("Crosswalk join must not multiply allocation pairs" =
            nrow(xwalk_join) == nrow(xwalk_target))

if ("rent_evidence_available" %in% names(xwalk_join)) {
  xwalk_join$rent_evidence_available[!xwalk_join$.acs_present] <- FALSE
}

acs_2024_bg_allocations <- xwalk_join |> select(-merge)
report_n(acs_2024_bg_allocations, "Retained target allocations (expected original link count)")

# Identify cross-boundary contributions for the Southern California parity audit.
socal_boundary_contributions_2024_bg_aggregated <- acs_2024_bg_allocations |>
  select_target_counties(tr2010_id, southern_california_counties) |>
  filter(if_any(all_of(weight_cols), ~ .x > 0)) |>
  filter(substr(bg2020_id, 1, 2) != "06" |
           !substr(bg2020_id, 3, 5) %in% southern_california_counties) |>
  transmute(tr2010_id, bg2020_id, across(all_of(weight_cols)),
            allocated_pop = popE * wt_pop, allocated_hh = hhE * wt_hh,
            allocated_hu = huE * wt_hu, allocated_rhu = rhuE * wt_renthu)
print(socal_boundary_contributions_2024_bg_aggregated, n = Inf, width = Inf)
socal_boundary_ids_2024_bg_aggregated <- unique(socal_boundary_contributions_2024_bg_aggregated$tr2010_id)

# Summarize source renter counts and rent.
check_moe_vars <- c("rhuE", "rentE")

check_moe_out_2024_bg_aggregated <- map_dfr(check_moe_vars, ~summ_var(acs_2024_bg_allocations, .x))
check_moe_out_2024_bg_aggregated

rm(xwalk, xwalk_sources, xwalk_join, acs_2024_bg_source, acs_sources)
```

## 2.3 Compute relative weights

### Decision: Relative weights for margin-of-error aggregation

Count estimates use NHGIS allocation fractions; count MOEs use each source's
share of its tract's allocated population, housing units, or renter units
(`rel_wt_*`). Missing required counts make these relative weights and dependent
MOEs missing, preventing an incomplete denominator from yielding a numeric zero.

```{r relative-weights-and-tc-2024-bg-aggregated}
assert_bg_contributors(acs_2024_bg_allocations, bg_reference_2024)
bg_original_allocations_2024 <- acs_2024_bg_allocations
bg_reconciliation_source_2024 <- bg_reconciliation_sources(bg_original_allocations_2024)
acs_2024_bg_allocations <- calc_rel_wt(acs_2024_bg_allocations, tr2010_id)
assert_bg_contributors(acs_2024_bg_allocations, bg_reference_2024)
```

## 2.4 Censor top-coded values and build structure-type aggregates

### Decision: Correct BG source rent while retaining component coverage

Classify BG B25064 evidence with the same source-dollar rules as native tracts.
Genuine `3500` estimates with supporting MOE/distribution evidence remain
observed; upper code `3501`, lower code `99`, known unavailability, and unresolved
evidence do not enter numeric source rent. The analyst approved correcting
`pct_miss_rent` accordingly: keep its allocated `rhuE` numerator/denominator,
positive `wt_renthu` weights, and completeness requirements. It remains the
share associated with missing or censored **BG source rent**, even when the
final tract selects native rent. It is not final-tract rent status.

Final-median classification occurs in §2.6. Lower-quartile rent and all
unrelated variables retain their rules.

Retain `med_hhincE` independently of rent availability so available incomes
contribute even where rent is missing or censored. The optional pre-censoring
expectations below support the income parity classification in §2.8.

```{r income-expectations-2024-bg-aggregated}
expected_income_2024_bg_aggregated <- NULL
if (!is.null(prior_outputs[["2024_bg_aggregated"]])) {
  expected_income_2024_bg_aggregated <- acs_2024_bg_allocations |>
    mutate(legacy_med_hhincE = if_else(is.na(rentE) | rentE >= 3500,
                                      NA_real_, med_hhincE)) |>
    group_by(tr2010_id) |>
    summarise(
      legacy_med_hhincE = weightedMean(legacy_med_hhincE, w = hhE * wt_hh, na.rm = TRUE),
      corrected_med_hhincE = weightedMean(med_hhincE, w = hhE * wt_hh, na.rm = TRUE),
      hh_complete = !is.na(strict_weighted_sum(hhE, wt_hh)),
      rhu_complete = !is.na(strict_weighted_sum(rhuE, wt_renthu)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(select(prior_outputs[["2024_bg_aggregated"]], tr2010_id, med_hhincM),
              by = "tr2010_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
    transmute(
      tr2010_id, legacy_med_hhincE,
      corrected_med_hhincE = if_else(hh_complete, corrected_med_hhincE, NA_real_),
      legacy_med_hhincCV = (med_hhincM / 1.645) / legacy_med_hhincE,
      corrected_med_hhincCV = if_else(rhu_complete,
                                     (med_hhincM / 1.645) / corrected_med_hhincE, NA_real_)
    )
  assert_tract_keys(expected_income_2024_bg_aggregated, target_tract_ids_2024_bg_aggregated, "2024 block-group-aggregated income expectations")
}
```

```{r censor-and-structure-2024-bg-aggregated}
summary(acs_2024_bg_allocations$rentE)
acs_2024_bg_allocations <- censor_bg_coverage_rent(acs_2024_bg_allocations)
summary(acs_2024_bg_allocations$rentE)

# Sum source structure categories before aggregation.
acs_2024_bg_allocations <- acs_2024_bg_allocations |>
    mutate(mfE= mf_5_9E + mf_10_19E + mf_20_49E + mf_50E,
           smfE= sfd_attE +duplexE + quadplexE
    )
```

## 2.5 Aggregate block groups to 2010 tracts

### Decision: Aggregate by measure family and require complete counts

- **Counts:** weighted sums using `wt_renthu` for renter measures, `wt_hu`
  for housing/structure measures, `wt_pop` for population, and `wt_hh` for households.
- **Income:** an available-income weighted mean with `hhE * wt_hh`. Its MOE
  is a weighted mean with `rhuE * wt_renthu`; income CV therefore
  requires both household and renter counts.
- **Count MOEs:** `sqrt(sum((MOE * rel_wt)^2))`, using the relative weights in §2.3.

Every positive-weight source must supply the required count; otherwise that
aggregate and its count-dependent results are missing. This prevents partial
totals from appearing complete. Observed zeros remain valid, zero-weight
missing values do not contribute, and a reference-confirmed empty contributor
set sums to zero. For `rhu_miss_rent`, source renter counts are required only
where rent is missing or censored.

Review county/family summaries for incomplete and zero-contributor targets.
`bg_count_qa_2024$measure` and `$missing_sources` retain full details beyond the
printed examples. Reconciliation uses original source values and the fixed
crosswalk reference, independently of the production sums.

```{r aggregate-to-tracts-2024-bg-aggregated}
# Reconcile keyed pairs/weights and measure-specific completeness immediately before sums.
bg_count_qa_2024 <- bg_aggregation_diagnostics(bg_reconciliation_source_2024, bg_reference_2024)
bg_county_family_qa_2024 <- bg_count_qa_2024$family |>
  mutate(county = substr(tr2010_id, 3, 5)) |>
  group_by(county, family) |>
  summarise(targets = n(), expected = sum(n_expected), matched = sum(n_matched),
            missing_links = sum(n_missing_links), missing_values = sum(n_missing_values),
            incomplete = sum(!complete), zero_contributors = sum(zero_contributors), .groups = "drop")
print(bg_county_family_qa_2024, n = Inf, width = Inf)
print(head(filter(bg_count_qa_2024$measure, !complete), 10L), width = Inf)
print(head(bg_count_qa_2024$missing_sources, 10L), width = Inf)
assert_bg_diagnostics(acs_2024_bg_allocations, bg_reference_2024, bg_count_qa_2024)

n_bg <- nrow(acs_2024_bg_allocations)
acs_2024_bg_aggregated <- calc_agg_vars(acs_2024_bg_allocations, tr2010_id)
cat(sprintf("Aggregated %s block-group rows to %s tract rows\n",
            formatC(n_bg, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
            formatC(nrow(acs_2024_bg_aggregated), format = "d", big.mark = ",")))
assert_tract_keys(acs_2024_bg_aggregated, target_tract_ids_2024_bg_aggregated, "2024 block-group-aggregated aggregated tracts")
```

### Decision: Aggregate supplemental housing counts

Aggregate vacancy, owner-occupied, and small-multifamily counts with `wt_hu`
for the structure and vacancy measures in §2.6. Rename `mfE` to `mf5E` after
`calc_agg_vars()`, which expects the source name, to identify units in 5+ structures.

```{r aggregate-supplemental-2024-bg-aggregated}
acs_2024_bg_aggregated <- acs_2024_bg_aggregated |>
  rename(mf5E = mfE)

vac_owner_2024_bg_aggregated <- acs_2024_bg_allocations |>
  group_by(tr2010_id) |>
  summarise(
    vac_forrentE = strict_weighted_sum(vac_forrentE, wt_hu),
    vac_forsaleE = strict_weighted_sum(vac_forsaleE, wt_hu),
    ohuE         = strict_weighted_sum(ohuE, wt_hu),
    smfE         = strict_weighted_sum(smfE, wt_hu),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

assert_tract_keys(vac_owner_2024_bg_aggregated, target_tract_ids_2024_bg_aggregated, "2024 block-group-aggregated supplemental counts")
acs_2024_bg_aggregated <- merge_df(acs_2024_bg_aggregated, vac_owner_2024_bg_aggregated, "tr2010_id")
table(acs_2024_bg_aggregated$merge)
assert_complete_tract_join(acs_2024_bg_aggregated, target_tract_ids_2024_bg_aggregated, "Supplemental count join")
count_reconciliation_2024 <- assert_bg_count_aggregates(
  acs_2024_bg_aggregated, acs_2024_bg_allocations, bg_reference_2024, bg_count_qa_2024
)
```

### Decision: Allocate all rental-inventory components with renter weights

Rental inventory adds renter-occupied units, vacant-for-rent units, and rented
but unoccupied units. Allocate all three source components with `wt_renthu`.
The separately aggregated `vac_forrentE` uses `wt_hu` for vacancy rates and
cannot substitute for inventory's renter-weighted vacancy component.

Any missing contributing component makes inventory missing; missing rent,
income, or MOEs do not. Zero-contributor targets have zero inventory. Component
totals and completeness diagnostics remain in `inventory_2024_bg_aggregated`;
only `rhu_inventoryE` joins the output.

```{r rental-inventory-2024-bg-aggregated}
assert_bg_contributors(acs_2024_bg_allocations, bg_reference_2024)
inventory_2024_bg_aggregated <- calc_rental_inventory(acs_2024_bg_allocations, tr2010_id, weight_col = "wt_renthu")
inventory_reference_qa_2024 <- assert_bg_inventory_reference(
  acs_2024_bg_allocations, bg_reference_2024, inventory_2024_bg_aggregated
)
assert_tract_keys(inventory_2024_bg_aggregated, acs_2024_bg_aggregated$tr2010_id, "2024 block-group-aggregated inventory diagnostics")
inventory_missing_sources_2024_bg_aggregated <- acs_2024_bg_allocations |>
  filter(wt_renthu > 0) |>
  select(tr2010_id, bg2020_id, wt_renthu, rhuE, vac_forrentE, vac_rentedE) |>
  pivot_longer(c(rhuE, vac_forrentE, vac_rentedE),
               names_to = "missing_component", values_to = "estimate") |>
  filter(is.na(estimate))
print(head(inventory_missing_sources_2024_bg_aggregated, 10L), width = Inf)
inventory_county_qa_2024_bg_aggregated <- inventory_2024_bg_aggregated |>
  dplyr::count(county = substr(tr2010_id, 3, 5), inventory_incomplete,
        zero_contributors = n_contributing == 0, name = "tracts")
print(inventory_county_qa_2024_bg_aggregated, n = Inf)

before_inventory_join <- acs_2024_bg_aggregated
acs_2024_bg_aggregated <- left_join(
  acs_2024_bg_aggregated, select(inventory_2024_bg_aggregated, tr2010_id, rhu_inventoryE),
  by = "tr2010_id", relationship = "one-to-one"
)
report_n(acs_2024_bg_aggregated, "2024 block-group-aggregated inventory join (expected unchanged tract count)")
stopifnot("Inventory join must preserve every existing 2024 column and row" =
            identical(acs_2024_bg_aggregated[names(before_inventory_join)], before_inventory_join))
rm(before_inventory_join)
assert_rental_inventory(acs_2024_bg_aggregated, inventory_2024_bg_aggregated, "2024 block-group-aggregated inventory after join")
inventory_reconciliation_2024_bg_aggregated <- reconcile_rental_inventory(
  acs_2024_bg_allocations, inventory_2024_bg_aggregated, tr2010_id, weight_col = "wt_renthu"
)
print(inventory_reconciliation_2024_bg_aggregated, width = Inf)
```

## 2.6 Derive interpolated rent, missingness, percentage, and CV measures

### Decision: Interpolate rent only from a complete distribution

Linearly interpolate within the dollar bounds of the median gross-rent category.
Require `rhucashE` and all 24 rent-bin counts, including bins after the median,
so a partial distribution cannot produce an apparently valid estimate. Treat
the endpoint categories (`<$100`, `$3,500+`) as open-ended and leave their
medians missing. The first bin whose cumulative count is **at least half**
determines the median: bin 24 gives `top_coded` and a $3,500 bound in 2024
dollars; exactly half reached below bin 24 remains non-top-coded.
`calc_interp_rent()` returns rent, `rent_median_bin`, `rent_status_reason`,
`tc_flag_rent_24`, `rent_status_24`, and `rent_censor_bound_24` together.
Incomplete counts, zero cash renters, or bin 1 give `unavailable_other`;
inconsistent counts or no positive contributors give `unresolved`. Bins must
sum to the cash-renter total within `1e-6`; that tolerance never alters the
median threshold. Missing positive-weight sources still fail contributor QA.

`nsfaE` counts attached single-family and multifamily units, excluding detached,
mobile, and other units. Vacancy rates use occupied units plus the corresponding
vacancy count as denominators; rental inventory is a separate measure.

```{r derive-measures-2024-bg-aggregated}
rent_contributors_2024 <- bg_count_qa_2024$family |> filter(family == "wt_renthu")
interp_rent_2024_bg_aggregated <- calc_interp_rent(
  acs_2024_bg_aggregated,
  rent_contributors_2024$n_expected[match(acs_2024_bg_aggregated$tr2010_id,
                                        rent_contributors_2024$tr2010_id)]
)
assert_tract_keys(interp_rent_2024_bg_aggregated, target_tract_ids_2024_bg_aggregated, "2024 block-group-aggregated interpolated rent")

acs_2024_bg_aggregated <- calc_missing_vars(acs_2024_bg_aggregated)
summary(acs_2024_bg_aggregated$pct_miss_rent)

acs_2024_bg_aggregated <- calc_pct_vars(acs_2024_bg_aggregated)

acs_2024_bg_aggregated <- calc_cv(acs_2024_bg_aggregated, source = "bg_agg")

acs_2024_bg_aggregated <- acs_2024_bg_aggregated |>
  mutate(
    nsfaE    = smfE + mf5E,
    pctrvacE = if_else((rhuE + vac_forrentE) > 0,
                       vac_forrentE / (rhuE + vac_forrentE), NA_real_),
    pctsvacE = if_else((ohuE + vac_forsaleE) > 0,
                       vac_forsaleE / (ohuE + vac_forsaleE), NA_real_)
  )
```

## 2.7 Merge rent and its metadata

```{r merge-flags-2024-bg-aggregated}
acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp <- merge_df(acs_2024_bg_aggregated, interp_rent_2024_bg_aggregated, "tr2010_id")
table(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp$merge)
assert_complete_tract_join(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, target_tract_ids_2024_bg_aggregated, "Interpolated rent join")
summary(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp$interp_rent, useNA = "ifany")
bg_dependent_qa_2024 <- assert_bg_dependent_measures(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, bg_count_qa_2024)
print(head(filter(bg_dependent_qa_2024$measure, !complete), 10L), width = Inf)
print(head(bg_dependent_qa_2024$missing_sources, 10L), width = Inf)
```

## 2.8 Save 2020–2024 block-group-aggregated output

Review `socal_parity_2024_bg_aggregated`: `difference_summary` counts changed
cells, `differences` retains their values, and `tracts` records membership changes.

- `verified_income_correction`, `verified_count_correction`, and
  `verified_rent_metadata_correction` require both the
  reference and candidate cell to match source-derived expectations. The
  expectations reconstruct rent-dependent income exclusions and partial-count
  sums solely to check comparisons with prior outputs.
- `boundary_review` requires inspection against
  `socal_boundary_contributions_2024_bg_aggregated` (§2.2): positive allocations
  from outside Southern California. All-zero links confer no exception, and
  boundary exposure does not justify unrelated input changes.
- `unexpected` changes or unaffected-tract membership changes stop execution.

Inspect `schema_changes` for the fixed allowance in §1.4. After saving, run §3
to check exact readback and reconciliation independently of parity availability.

```{r acceptance-2024-bg-aggregated}
report_tract_counties(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, target_counties, "2024 block-group-aggregated destination counties")
assert_rental_inventory(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, inventory_2024_bg_aggregated, "2024 block-group-aggregated inventory before save")
assert_bg_contributors(acs_2024_bg_allocations, bg_reference_2024)
count_reconciliation_2024 <- assert_bg_count_aggregates(
  acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, bg_reconciliation_source_2024, bg_reference_2024, bg_count_qa_2024
)
assert_bg_dependent_measures(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, bg_count_qa_2024)
expected_count_corrections_2024 <- if (is.null(prior_outputs[["2024_bg_aggregated"]])) NULL else {
  bg_count_parity_expectations(acs_2024_bg_allocations, bg_reference_2024, bg_original_allocations_2024)
}
socal_parity_2024_bg_aggregated <- compare_socal_parity(
  acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, prior_outputs[["2024_bg_aggregated"]], southern_california_counties,
  socal_boundary_ids_2024_bg_aggregated, expected_income = expected_income_2024_bg_aggregated, schema_migration = "2024",
  expected_count_corrections = expected_count_corrections_2024,
  expected_rent = bg_rent_parity_expectations(bg_original_allocations_2024, interp_rent_2024_bg_aggregated)
)
```

```{r save-2024-bg-aggregated}
report_n(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, "2024 block-group-aggregated tract measures to save")

cat("Writing/replacing", file.path(data_dir, "acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated.feather"), "\n")
save_data(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, data_dir, "acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated.feather")
```

# 3. Validate outputs

Reload the saved output and check it against the in-memory result and original
source diagnostics.

```{r reload-step2}
acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out <- arrow::read_feather(paste0(data_dir, "acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated.feather"))
```

## 3.1 Check key uniqueness and duplicates

```{r validate-keys-step2}
cat("acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated:", nrow(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out), "rows |",
    n_distinct(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out$tr2010_id), "unique tr2010_id |",
    sum(duplicated(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out$tr2010_id)), "duplicate ids\n")
assert_tract_keys(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, target_tract_ids_2024_bg_aggregated, "Saved 2024 block-group-aggregated tract keys")
assert_same_schema(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp, "Saved 2024 block-group-aggregated schema")
assert_step2_cleanup(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, "2024")
```

## 3.2 Check missingness on critical variables

Review missing `interp_rent` using the exclusions in §2.6; no empirical
missingness threshold is imposed.

```{r validate-missingness-step2}
cat("acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated missing tr2010_id:", sum(is.na(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out$tr2010_id)), "\n")
cat("acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated missing interp_rent:", sum(is.na(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out$interp_rent)), "\n")
cat("acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated missing mf5E:", sum(is.na(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out$mf5E)), "\n")
```

## 3.3 Check flag-variable encoding

```{r validate-flags-step2}
flag_cols_2024_bg_aggregated <- grep("^(m_flag_|zero_flag_|tc_flag_)", names(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out), value = TRUE)
for (f in flag_cols_2024_bg_aggregated) {
  cat("acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated", f, "-> class:", class(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out[[f]]),
      "| values:", paste(sort(unique(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out[[f]])), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  stopifnot(typeof(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out[[f]]) == "double",
            all(is.na(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out[[f]]) | acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out[[f]] %in% c(0, 1)))
}
```

## 3.4 Summarize numeric variable distributions

Inspect negative counts, shares outside [0, 1], and implausible rents.

```{r validate-numeric-step2}
print_numeric_summary(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, "acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated")
```

## 3.5 Check county coverage and missing/top-coded rent

Review final status/reason counts separately from `pct_miss_rent`. The coverage
check reconstructs its numerator from corrected original BG evidence and
unchanged renter weights; incomplete or zero denominators remain missing.
The [migration and impact report](README.md#rent-metadata-migration) describes
potential downstream quality-screen changes.

```{r validate-county-rent-step2}
report_tract_counties(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, target_counties, "Saved 2024 block-group-aggregated counties")
bind_rows(
  acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out |>
    transmute(county = substr(tr2010_id, 3, 5), rent_value = interp_rent,
              rent_measure = "interp_rent", product = "2024_bg_aggregated")
) |>
  group_by(product, rent_measure, county) |>
  summarise(tracts = n(), missing_rent = sum(is.na(rent_value)),
            missing_share = mean(is.na(rent_value)), .groups = "drop") |>
  print(n = Inf)
assert_rent_metadata(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, "interp_rent", "24")
print(dplyr::count(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, rent_status_24, rent_status_reason), n = Inf)
# Reconcile coverage against corrected BG source rent, preserving renter weights.
coverage_expected <- bg_reconciliation_source_2024 |>
  group_by(tr2010_id) |>
  summarise(numerator = strict_weighted_sum(
    if_else(is.na(rentE), rhuE, 0), wt_renthu),
    denominator = strict_weighted_sum(rhuE, wt_renthu), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(expected = if_else(denominator > 0, numerator / denominator, NA_real_))
coverage_expected <- coverage_expected[match(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out$tr2010_id,
                                             coverage_expected$tr2010_id), ]
stopifnot("Component coverage must match corrected source missingness" = isTRUE(all.equal(
  acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out$pct_miss_rent, coverage_expected$expected, tolerance = 1e-10)))
shares <- acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out$pct_miss_rent
stopifnot(all(is.na(shares) | (is.finite(shares) & shares >= -1e-10 & shares <= 1 + 1e-10)))
```

## 3.6 Check count, dependent-measure, and inventory reconciliation

Inspect `inventory_missing_sources_2024_bg_aggregated` and the county summary
for missing components and zero-contributor targets. Inventory reconciliation
compares source-first and target-first totals over **complete targets only**;
this total does not estimate inventory for the entire sample.

Saved counts and inventory must reconcile with the original sources, while
incomplete measures and their dependent results must remain missing.
`saved_dependent_qa_2024` retains affected measures and missing-source details.

```{r validate-rental-inventory-step2}
assert_rental_inventory(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, inventory_2024_bg_aggregated, "Saved 2024 block-group-aggregated inventory")
stopifnot(`Saving must preserve every 2024 block-group-aggregated value and row` = identical(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out,
    acs_2024_bg_aggregated_interp))
print(head(inventory_missing_sources_2024_bg_aggregated, 10L), width = Inf)
print(bind_rows(`2024_bg_aggregated` = inventory_county_qa_2024_bg_aggregated, .id = "product"), n = Inf,
    width = Inf)
print(bind_rows(`2024_bg_aggregated` = reconcile_rental_inventory(acs_2024_bg_allocations, inventory_2024_bg_aggregated,
    tr2010_id, weight_col = "wt_renthu"), .id = "product"), n = Inf, width = Inf)
assert_bg_inventory_reference(bg_original_allocations_2024, bg_reference_2024, inventory_2024_bg_aggregated)
assert_bg_contributors(acs_2024_bg_allocations, bg_reference_2024)
saved_count_reconciliation_2024 <- assert_bg_count_aggregates(
  acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, bg_reconciliation_source_2024, bg_reference_2024, bg_count_qa_2024
)
saved_dependent_qa_2024 <- assert_bg_dependent_measures(acs_2024_bg_aggregated_out, bg_count_qa_2024)
```
